item.title: 4.1.1-beta8
item.description:
• Add a Show seconds option for the popover clocks (Settings → Appearance)
  • Add a separate Seconds toggle for the menu-bar clock (Settings → Menu Bar)
  • Fix cities added right after launch being removed by the automatic location lookup
  • Fix the menu-bar clock lagging up to a minute after turning off seconds display
  • Fix the Home city losing its flag after migration for some users
  • Improve the reliability of update delivery

• Time Travel now spans your full forward/back range — set each direction up to 30 days (defaults: 1 day back, 7 days forward).
  • Redesigned time-travel slider: it drags at a steady, gentle rate with no hyper-sensitive jumps on wide ranges, and you can hold at either edge to keep scrolling.
  • Fixed: the time slider is now draggable while the popover is floating.

item.title: 4.0.2-beta3
item.description:
• Redesigned time-travel slider: it now drags at a steady, gentle rate (no more hyper-sensitive jumps on wide ranges), and you can hold at either edge to keep scrolling.
  • Time Travel now spans your full forward/back range — defaults to 1 day back / 7 days forward, and each can be set up to 30 days.
  • Fixed: the time slider is now draggable while the popover is floating.

item.title: 4.0.2-beta2
item.description:
• Time travel slider now scrubs your full Travel forward/back range (it was capped at about 12 hours).
  • Time Travel defaults are now 1 day back / 7 days forward, and either direction can be set up to 30 days.

item.title: 4.0.2-beta1
item.description: • Time travel: the slider now scrubs your full Travel forward/back range instead of stopping at about 12 hours.
• Internal cleanup: removed legacy code left over from the 4.0 redesign. No feature or behavior changes.

• Meridian 4.0 "Daybreak" — a complete visual redesign. Your cities and settings carry over automatically.
  • New Daybreak popover with a living sky that shifts through dawn, day, dusk, and night for your current location
  • Every city shows a sun or moon that flips live as it crosses its own sunrise and sunset
  • Redesigned city cards showing each place's time and how far ahead or behind it is right now
  • Reimagined time-travel scrubber — drag to glide through the hours, or double-click any time to type one
  • Brand-new native Settings window: Cities, Menu Bar, Appearance, Time Travel, and General
  • Custom labels and per-city color dots; pick a Home city while your current location follows your Mac
  • Five menu-bar density presets plus an opt-in two-line "Stacked" layout for narrow or notched menu bars
  • Accent color themes, adjustable text size, and a configurable time-travel range
  • Float the popover on top and drag it anywhere; copy all city times to the clipboard
  • System-wide hotkey (default ⌃⌥⌘T) opens Meridian from any app — reliable from anywhere, no error beep
  • Export and import your settings to back them up or move to another Mac
  • New "Midnight Sundial" app icon, smarter city search, and full localization in 15 languages
  • Open Manual button in Settings → General links to the online user guide

item.title: 4.0.0-beta33

item.title: 4.0.0-beta30
item.description:
• New Stacked menu bar layout: each starred city's name shows above its time, fitting more cities in a narrow or notched menu bar (Settings, Menu Bar)
  • New Midnight Sundial app icon, plus a refreshed menu bar icon
  • Settings buttons are easier to see in dark mode
  • The popover now opens just below the menu bar instead of flush against it
  • New installs start at login and check for updates daily by default

item.title: 4.0.0-beta22

item.title: 4.0.0-beta21
item.description:
• Introducing Daybreak — a brand-new look for Meridian
  • New menu bar popover with a live day/night view and per-city sunrise/sunset
  • Redesigned Settings window
  • New accent color themes that tint the whole app
  • Single-line menu bar item with per-city color dots
  • Copy all city times to the clipboard from the popover
  • Float the popover on top and drag it anywhere on screen

  • Fix the Export Log button getting clipped in Settings → About
  • Fix the selected Settings tab being hard to read on macOS Tahoe

• Fix Meridian's icon not appearing in the menu bar on macOS Tahoe (#125)

item.title: 3.0.1-beta1
item.description: • Internal refactors only — no user-visible changes (#113, #114, #115, #116)

• **Now requires macOS 26 (Tahoe) or later.**
  • Updated geocoding to Apple's modern MapKit APIs (#117).
• Menubar always uses Compact mode now; the Standard mode option was removed (#121)

• Fix multiple favorited timezones not appearing in compact menu bar mode (Sequoia/Tahoe regression)
  • Toggle a favorite on/off in compact mode now updates the menu bar immediately, no relaunch needed
  • Standard mode no longer wraps onto two lines after switching from compact mode
  • Add an (i) info button next to the Accent Color picker explaining the team color approximations

• Add 10s timeout to geocoding so the app no longer hangs on a stalled network
  • Internal: convert IUO statusBarHandler to lazy var, dedup JSON-name enum boilerplate, name magic timing/layout literals, tighten over-public properties

• Fix rare crashes when the system timezone database is incomplete
  • Harden city search URL handling against unexpected input
  • Localize slider button tooltips
  • Restrict exported debug log file to user-only permissions
  • Improve reliability of menu bar timer and panel observer cleanup

• Add F1 team accent color picker in Settings → Appearance — choose from any of the 11 2026 constructors. Default is Aston Martin.
  • Fix Sparkle beta channel auto-updates that were silently treating beta versions as equivalent and never offering newer betas.

item.title: 2.20.1-beta1
item.description: • Internal release tooling fix (no user-facing changes)

• Add opt-in beta release channel — enable in About to receive pre-release builds (#98)
  • Fix Appearance preferences tab crashing on click

• Remove unused notes feature on each timezone row (#84)
  • Center favourite checkbox and timezone/label text in Settings (#84)
  • Improve home timezone indicator — match runtime system timezone in addition to persisted flag

• Add direct time entry: double-click any time and type a new value to update all timezones (#85)
  • Add settings export and import: backup or restore preferences and timezones from the About tab (#83)
  • Add Copy All button to copy every timezone's time to the clipboard at once (#86)
  • Improve slider feel: 1:1 tracking, 15-minute snap, always-visible navigation buttons (#85)
  • Auto-default timezone labels to the city name when added by identifier (#82)
  • Add tooltips to the row options button and the float-mode drag handle (#84)
  • Redesign About tab: auto-update controls grouped together, cleaner layout (#81)
  • Cleaner panel footer

• Add pin-to-desktop mode: panel floats above all windows, is draggable, and remembers its position (#70)
  • Fix preferences window opening off-center
  • Show app version and last-checked date in the panel footer and About tab
  • Fix automatic updates not working for some users who installed Meridian before 2.12 (#75)
  • Fix last-checked date not refreshing after a background update check
  • Fix updates stalling on menu bar apps — updates now install immediately without waiting for a quit
• Internal cleanup: remove dead code. No user-facing changes.
• Add Sparkle update-check activity to the app log for easier troubleshooting
• Fix auto-updates not installing for users who keep Meridian running
• Fix last-checked timestamp not refreshing after automatic update checks (#77)
• Fix automatic updates not installing for some users (#75)
• Fix boolean blindness and improve test assertion messages
• Code quality and security improvements: eliminate per-second deserialization, remove unnecessary network entitlement, fix timezone DST detection
• Code quality improvements: flatten nesting, add error logging, fix silent failures, reduce per-tick allocations
• Add pin-to-desktop floating window mode (#70)
• Update Sparkle to 2.9.1, fixing a potential crash during update installation
• Show last update-check date in About tab below the auto-update checkbox
• Show app version and last update-check time in the panel footer
• Remove broken xcresulttool CI step
• Center preferences window on screen

• Fix Export Log to include all sessions, not just current
  • Enlarge About tab to fit debug logging controls
• Fix Export Log button not working

• Add keyboard shortcuts (#50)
  • Fix copy-paste bug in analytics logging
  • Remove force unwraps that could crash in edge cases
  • Add search input length validation
  • Add production observability logging visible in Console.app
  • Add debug logging toggle in Settings > About
  • Add crash detection for unclean exits
  • Add troubleshooting docs to README

• Fixes Denver (and any other timezone-identifier entry) not showing sunrise/sunset
  • Root cause: geocoding can fail silently when a timezone is added via identifier, leaving coordinates permanently nil
  • On each app launch, any timezone with missing coordinates is now geocoded from the city name in its timezone ID (e.g. "Denver" from "America/Denver") and the result is persisted
  • Works together with #53 (row height fix) to fully resolve the issue

• Sunrise/sunset was only displayed for timezones added via city search (`selectionType == .city`)
  • Timezones added via timezone identifier (e.g. America/Denver) have `selectionType == .timezone` and were excluded, even when they had valid latitude/longitude coordinates
  • Fix: check for presence of coordinates instead of selection type

• Fix the "Automatically download and install updates" checkbox reverting to unchecked every time the About tab is opened
  • Root cause: Sparkle requires `automaticallyChecksForUpdates` to be `true` for `automaticallyDownloadsUpdates` to persist — we were only setting the latter
  • Now both properties are set together when the toggle changes
  • Added `onAppear` to re-sync the checkbox state from Sparkle when the view appears
  • Default to enabled for new users (one-time setup on first launch)

• Add standard macOS keyboard shortcuts when the panel is open: ⌘Q (quit), ⌘, (settings), ⌘W (close panel), ⌘C (copy first timezone to clipboard)
  • Show shortcut hints in the "More Options" context menu for discoverability
  • Fix Escape key handling to prevent system beep

• Restore internationalization with 15 languages via String Catalogs
  • Add Homebrew cask support (brew install --cask tpak/tpak/meridian)
  • Translations recovered from original Clocker project — credit to Abhishek Banthia, Ping (milotype), and Crowdin community

• Harden security: enable secure coding, fix retain cycles, remove crash-on-unknown-auth
  • Improve performance: cache fonts/images, fix DateFormatter aliasing bug, skip redundant layout
  • Code quality: remove unnecessary NSObject, fix dependency injection, extract named constants
  • Add 36 new unit tests (112 → 148 total) covering critical formatting and serialization paths
  • Add deployment guide for returning after months away

• Adds "Automatically download and install updates" checkbox to the About tab
  • Controls Sparkle's `automaticallyDownloadsUpdates` setting
  • Placed between "Start at Login" and "Check for Updates" controls
• Test Sparkle auto-update
• Fix Sparkle auto-update for sandboxed apps
• Test Sparkle auto-update
• Fix Sparkle auto-update for sandboxed apps
• Test Sparkle auto-update

• Developer ID signed and notarized releases
  • Auto-collect release notes from merged PRs
  • Document release workflow in CLAUDE.md
• Properly signed and notarized for Gatekeeper
• Fix crash on launch after Sparkle update (library validation entitlement)

• Complete rebrand: all internal references renamed from Clocker to Meridian
  • Menu items now say "About Meridian", "Hide Meridian", "Quit Meridian"

• Fix slow startup caused by coordinate geocoding on every launch
  • Move Start at Login and Check for Updates to About tab
